subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should durable wakes cross session-generation resets as canonical-key `systemEvent` entries, and which of the two open PR5 branches should become the sole landing candidate?
rationale: Both queue-handoff semantics and branch selection affect persisted session behavior; no mechanical code repair can determine whether an old wake should reach a newly reset conversation.

options.title: Adopt one fenced canonical PR
options.body: Select one PR5 branch, rebase it on the accepted predecessors, document queue-handoff semantics, and require attached-session restart/reset proof before merge.

options.title: Accept cross-generation delivery
options.body: Intentionally allow queued durable system events to reach the current generation for the canonical session key and document that behavior as the durable contract.

options.title: Stop at inspection-only
options.body: Defer automatic session handoff and keep durable wakes operator-inspectable until reset and delivery semantics have a stronger product design.

recommendation.title: Adopt one fenced canonical PR
recommendation.body: Select one PR5 branch, rebase it on the accepted predecessors, document queue-handoff semantics, and require attached-session restart/reset proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this contributor to the shared session-delivery invariants affected by the decision.
